{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the 'severity' column has no missing values and only the expected categories
assert trial_df['severity'].isnull().sum() == 0, "There are missing values in 'severity'"
assert set(trial_df['severity'].unique()) == {'mild', 'severe', 'moderate'}, "Unexpected severity categories"

# Count the number of patients with 'severe' severity
severe_count = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]

# Total number of enrolled patients
total_enrolled = trial_df.shape[0]

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_enrolled

# Print the fraction
fraction_severe"}
